# ConfirmationCheck

The order-confirmed icon. Animated, the circle draws over 540ms while it grows from 30%, turns 175° and its stroke thins from 9 to 2; then the tick draws over 380ms. Static, it is the finished icon. In `Checkout` the 96px animated one flies to where the 50px static one sits.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/confirmationcheck)

## Usage

```tsx
<ConfirmationCheck size={96} animated />
<ConfirmationCheck />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | `number` | Pixels. 96 at the centre of the screen, 50 beside the heading. |
| `animated` | `boolean` | Draw it. Change its key to play again. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `ConfirmationCheck.module.css`
- `ConfirmationCheck.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
